events.title: Tribute to Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Remembering the influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot dead in Las Vegas on this day in 1996. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years since his untimely passing, Tupac Shakur's impact on music and culture remains undeniable. What's your favourite track from the legend?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: On this day, we pay tribute to the legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who passed away in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: The world lost a true musical pioneer when Jimi Hendrix left us in 1970. His guitar work continues to inspire generations. What's his most iconic riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969, featuring that legendary zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From 'Come Together' to 'Here Comes the Sun', it's packed with classics. What's your top track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde, frontwoman of The Pretenders.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating the one and only Chrissie Hynde, who turns 75 today. A true rock icon with a voice that commands attention. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Oasis and Beady Eye frontman, Liam Gallagher.

angles.name: Biblical Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to Liam Gallagher – still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971, carrying a message that still resonates today.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless song with a message of peace and unity. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple released the first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising how we listened to music forever.

angles.name: Music in your Pocket
angles.copy: Can you believe it's been 25 years since the first iPod dropped? It completely changed how we carried our tunes. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the first 007 film premiere, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Time to decide: who's your favourite Bond, and what's the ultimate 007 theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the visionary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Vision
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the iconic British comedian and actor, John Cleese.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. Which track from it stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: On this day, we pay tribute to the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Queen's King
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the legend, Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are simply unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965, marking a pivotal shift in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your top pick from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: On this solemn day, we remember the tragic loss of John Lennon, who was senselessly murdered in 1980. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago, the world fell silent with the news of John Lennon's passing. His music and message of peace live on. What does his legacy mean to you?
